stemMd: Which polynomial is equal to (x − 1)(x² + x + 1)?
explanationMd: Multiply: x³ + x² + x − x² − x − 1. The x² and x terms cancel, leaving x³ − 1. This is the factorization of a difference of cubes.

distractorRationale.a: The sign is wrong for the difference-of-cubes identity.
distractorRationale.b: This fails to combine cancelling middle terms.
distractorRationale.e: This introduces terms absent from the product.
